integrity: A deterministic complete face-poset acyclic matching and an independently computed simplicial homology and character check are supplied with full Python standard-library source and actual output; calculations are reproducible and not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Exact computation is for the ten-vertex Petersen graph only; homology representation decomposition is over Q; an integral Z[S5] lattice decomposition and an equivariant homotopy equivalence are not asserted. Prior coverage in unindexed sources remains possible.
title: Six fifth-dimensional spheres and irreducible symmetry in the Petersen induced-forest complex
